evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this is more than enough time' but never frames the 10-15 minute call structure or waits for customer confirmation before diving into probing. The framing is incomplete.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing (zip codes, addresses, storage details) without asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns raised by customer
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised by customer
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (storage + apartment), floors (4th floor storage, 17th floor apartment), room count (2 bedroom apartment, 10x15 storage), walking distance (storage truck to unit ~50 yards; unit to elevator ~20-30 meters), additional rooms (sister's house stop), special considerations (loading dock 11am-3pm window, high-rise, three-stop move), fragile items (kitchen glassware, frames) — all covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Never asked. Customer volunteered ~50 boxes but rep did not ask the box-count/overflow check question.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives typical range ('five to seven hours' for 10x15 storage) and personalizes to this move: 'five and a half to six and a half hour mark' accounting for the extra stop at sister's house and high-rise building. Estimated budget: $1,326.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep covers hourly rate ($204/two movers), all-inclusive framing (no credit card fees, taxes, fuel, assembly/reassembly), trip fees/overnight not explicitly mentioned, but does cover 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute billing increments ('we don't charge you for the full hour right away'). Full framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep says 'Alright, now, if that's all good with you, would you like our help for this move on Friday' — jumps to the ask without pausing to gauge the customer's reaction to the price or confirming the customer feels the estimate is fair.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep states 'if we run late on the time we schedule, we provide discounts by the end of the day' — covers the discount terms and the core promise.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep says 'we will also include other features like our no worries damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any repair, replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages' — covers amount and framing as built-in (no deductible/fine-print language not explicitly stated, but stated as included feature).
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep never asks a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirms the customer is satisfied with the two promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Alright just let us know, send us those photos. We can review it with you, yeah, okay, no worries.' This is a logistics wrap-up, not a genuine 'what's still concerning you?' check. Later asks customer 'but in the storage, how many beds do you have there?' — this is clarifying details, not checking final concerns. Throwaway-level engagement.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No catch-all ('Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?') is asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asks plainly: 'would you like our help for this move on Friday' — no softening or built-in out. Customer then responds asking to meet at 9am, and rep says 'So would you like to go ahead and get on the schedule on Friday? Do you want us to book this move for you?' — explicit and clean.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states 'We don't take deposits at this time so there's no verse and securing a spot as well. So if you need to make changes later all you have to do is let us know' — confirms no deposit/rate is secure upon booking.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Confirmed: date (Friday Oct 2), phone (201-936-0796 already gathered in Section 1), arrival window (9:00–9:30 AM at storage), crew size (two movers initially, with note to review photos for possible third), from address (Public Storage, unit 4201 — customer to confirm), to address (5250 Brown Way, apartment 1718, 17th floor). Partially confirmed: storage unit number uncertain (customer said '4201 or 4001'), sister's address given but not explicitly confirmed as second stop in booking details.

top_strength: Comprehensive logistics discovery — the rep gathered nearly all seven logistics items (property types, floors, distances, special considerations, fragile items) and handled a complex three-stop move with clarity and confidence.
coaching_note: Never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — the single highest-value question in the script was skipped entirely, and critical offers like packing services and box-count overflow check were never presented.
